questions.why: Checking the overview screen for the pending mobile check deposit confirms that the bank has successfully received and is processing the funds.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: Delegating this step means you lose the immediate peace of mind of seeing the pending deposit reflected in your own account balance.
questions.check: Does the pending list show the deposited check?
questions.say_example: The check shows in pending, <100.25>.

questions.question: Does the account history display your recent transfer with the correct reference number and date?
questions.why: Checking the history tab for the reference number and date confirms that the bank's system has officially recorded your transaction.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the immediate reassurance of personally verifying the official reference number and timestamp of your completed transfer.
questions.check: Does the history show the transfer with the expected reference and date?
questions.say_example: The transfer is in the history with reference <[reference number]>, dated today.

questions.question: What is the exact status of your request and the expected timeline for resolution?
questions.why: The screen shows an 'In Progress' status with a specific timeline of 5 working days for resolution, which dictates when the bank will finish processing the request.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the ability to personally verify the official processing timeline and manage their own expectations for the document's arrival.
questions.check: What status and timeline does the request's tracking screen show?
questions.say_example: The request shows In Progress, resolution in 5 working days.

questions.question: Is the newly generated digital replacement card visible on your dashboard?
questions.why: Seeing the new card entry ending in [card number] with the 'View Digital Card' button confirms the replacement was successful and is ready for immediate use.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You miss the peace of mind of personally verifying the new card details and knowing exactly when the digital version becomes available while waiting for the physical mail.
questions.check: Does the dashboard show the new digital card?
questions.say_example: The new digital card ending <[card number]> is on the dashboard, ready to use.
